ficha_publicada.complicacoes: Identity: Hawkman’s multiple incarnations can occasionally complicate his life and confuse his allies. He may run into other versions of himself or run afoul of Thangarian spies seeking to clandestinely remove him from action so they might themselves pose as Hawkman. Relationship: Most of Hawkman’s incarnations have had an ongoing romantic relationship with either Hawkgirl or Hawkwoman.
